corrections_to_pr_2474.subject: leaf 0x24 block reach
corrections_to_pr_2474.pr_2474_claim: the leaf 0x24 OR reaches only bits 53, 57 and 58 (README stage 5 (d); pin name 'leaf 0x24 bit 57 and 58 constant' at 0x5cae34d)
corrections_to_pr_2474.byte_verified: the default word at 0x5cae34d is 0x60000000000000 (bits 53, 54) and the cmove substitute at 0x5cae343 is 0x20000000000000 (bit 53): the block reaches bits 53 and 54, with bit 54 conditional on leaf 0x24 ebx bits 1..7. a bits 57 and 58 come only from the early composition (leaf 7.0 ebx bits 3 and 8)

corrections_to_pr_2474.subject: fall-through leaf 1 ecx bit 12 landing bit
corrections_to_pr_2474.pr_2474_claim: a bit 44 driver (field_map C0 bit 44, second entry; README stage 5 (e))
corrections_to_pr_2474.byte_verified: and edx,0x1000 / shl rdx,0x2c at 0x5cae0d1/0x5cae0d7 lands the term at bit 56 (12 + 0x2c); a bit 44 has the single shared-block source leaf 7.0 edx bit 25

corrections_to_pr_2474.subject: bit 25 compare operand
corrections_to_pr_2474.pr_2474_claim: unsigned compare of leaf 7.0 ebx (r13) against the saved composed word (rcx) at 0x5cae1cc (field_map C0 bit 25)
corrections_to_pr_2474.byte_verified: ecx is loaded with the constant 0x80000000 at 0x5cae160, after the saved composed word in rcx was consumed by the restore or r12,rcx at 0x5cae14f; the compare at 0x5cae1cc therefore decides on leaf 7.0 ebx bit 31 alone, and bit 25 is that bit under the extra-block gate

selection.condition: rcx = (r12 bit 14) | (vendor != "GenuineIntel" compare residue) is nonzero
selection.a_rule: A = r12 if the condition holds, else r12 & 0xf9ffffffffffbfff
selection.b_rule: B = r15 if the condition holds, else zero-extended low 32 bits of r15
selection.source: pr #2474 (cited): with the complete map, B has no bit at or above 12 on any path, so the b_rule's zero-extension never changes B's value, C1's B-driven bits are confined to 1..12, and C2 = (B >> 62) | H = H on every path

suffix.equations: C0 = A | H; C1 = ((B << 1) | (A >> 63)) | H; C2 = (B >> 62) | H; raw rax return = A (merged RE-002 cache-publication packet)

early_paths.max_leaf_zero: 0x5caddf3 jumps to the suffix with A = 0 and B = 0; the leaf is never called (pr #2474)
early_paths.region_gate: unless cpuid leaf 1 ecx bits 26,27 are both set, 0x5cae042 jumps to 0x5cae251 and then to the selection at 0x5cae35e; the leaf is never called and none of the xcr0 terms executes (pr #2474). on this path A is the early composition alone and B is the early composition alone

limits: Complete bit-level source map for the composed words A (R12) and B (R15) at the selection entry 0x5cae35e of the node #115 refresh helper only. The XCR0-side attribution, the region gates and the selection/suffix rules are PR #2474's and the merged RE-002 cache-publication packet's, cited not re-derived; three byte-level corrections to PR #2474 are recorded under corrections_to_pr_2474. Feature/ISA names for any bit, runtime CPUID/XCR0 values, the detector's use of C0-C2 downstream, and the maximum-leaf-zero path (which bypasses the selection) are not claimed. The provenance is a static may-analysis over the pinned disassembly: a bit's support lists every input bit its value or its selecting condition can depend on; for A bit 25 the recorded support names the deciding bit of the pinned compare, and the tool asserts the condition mentions no input family other than leaf 7.0 ebx. No captured code executed.

provenance.method: per-bit value/condition provenance fixpoint over the helper control-flow graph, measured at the selection entry; a conditional-move condition is merged into a bit's condition provenance only where the two arms' value provenance for that bit differs; sete results are value provenance; CPUID sites inject the pinned leaf/subleaf atoms; the single call site injects the XCR0 result of pr #2398
provenance.asserted: for every bit of A and B, (value provenance union condition provenance) minus the constant marker equals the support recorded in field_map; A bit 25 is asserted by subset (its compare condition may mention only leaf 7.0 ebx) with empty non-constant value provenance; no call-result atom reaches A or B
